messages.author: e83d54ec65b5b8e6
messages.subject: Re: Suppress legend for second geom
parts: This should solve your problem
ggplot(DF1, aes(x=dvs, y=value, col=variable)) + geom_line(lwd = 1.5) +
geom_point(data=DF2, mapping=aes(x=dvs, y=value), shape=15, size=2, show.legend=FALSE,inherit.aes=FALSE)
